hero.title: Worldwide air freight, delivered with confidence
hero.text: Time-critical air freight services from Europe to Africa and beyond – we deliver your cargo safely to its destination with speed, efficiency and care.

introduction.text: For time-critical and high-value shipments, we coordinate air freight from European airports to destinations across our network,
introduction.accent: with careful handling and clear communication from take-off to arrival.

efficiency.title: Speed meets cost efficiency
efficiency.text: Tailor-made logistics services from Europe to Africa by road, air, water or rail – we deliver your cargo safely to its destination with efficiency and care.

process.title: Cargo purchase & negotiations
process.text: For specific requests, we start by liaising with your suppliers, making transportation arrangements and purchasing your products on your behalf, with optimal payment facilitation.

process.title: Booking & export preparation
process.text: Once the route is agreed, the shipment is prepared for collection and airport handling. DEexpress supports the export-document process and coordinates the handovers required before departure.

process.title: Arrival, customs clearing & handling
process.text: We handle the customs process in the destination airport, with filing of complete paperwork and other regulatory obligations.

process.title: Onward coordination
process.text: At destination, the next handover is planned around the confirmed route. Where available, the service continues from airport handling to final delivery coordination.

hero.title: Personal effects, delivered with care
hero.text: Laptops, home appliances, luggage and everyday belongings — shipped from Europe with personal service and careful coordination, whether you are sending one item or several.

introduction.text: DEExpress provides tailored shipping for the personal items you need or want to send to others. From a laptop or home appliance to clothing, luggage and boxed belongings,
introduction.accent: we bring practical guidance and careful handling to every stage of the journey.

capabilities: Laptops, home appliances and personal belongings
Air and sea freight options from Europe

efficiency.title: One item or several. Care at every stage.
efficiency.text: Your shipment is planned around the belongings you are sending, the time you have and the destination ahead. We connect collection, storage where needed and international transport in one manageable plan.

process.title: Your items & your shipping needs
process.text: A laptop, a home appliance or a few boxes for family — tell us what you are sending and where it needs to go. We review the item details, size and preferred timing to plan a suitable air or sea freight route from Europe.

process.title: Packing guidance & collection
process.text: Different items need different preparation. We provide packing guidance for your shipment and review any special handling needs before collection, bringing the item list, paperwork and collection arrangements together.

process.title: Export preparation & shipping
process.text: With your belongings ready, we coordinate export-document support and the handover for international transport. Where storage is needed before departure, we discuss the arrangements as part of your shipment plan.

process.title: Arrival & final handover
process.text: As your shipment arrives, we coordinate the destination handover and guide you through the next steps. Collection or onward delivery is planned around the agreed service, with availability confirmed for your destination.

work.title: We handle the work that matters the most

items.title: Personal shipment planning
items.text: Air and sea freight options reviewed around your belongings, destination and timing, with the service agreed before collection.

items.title: Preparation & paperwork
items.text: Practical packing advice, item-list guidance and export-document support to help prepare your belongings for the journey.

items.title: Collection & storage
items.text: Collection and departure arrangements brought together, with storage support when your shipment is ready ahead of its departure date.

items.title: Arrival & handover
items.text: Destination arrangements explained clearly, with collection or onward delivery coordinated around the confirmed service.

items.question: Can I ship a laptop or home appliance?
items.answer: Yes. Personal effects shipping includes laptops and home appliances, as well as clothing, luggage and other personal belongings. Share the item type, model, condition and destination so we can confirm suitability and preparation requirements for your shipment. Let us know about any batteries or special handling needs before booking.

items.question: Can I send just one item?
items.answer: Yes. You do not need to be relocating or sending a full household shipment. We can help with a single personal item or several boxes, with the route planned around what you are sending.

items.question: What do you need to prepare a quote?
items.answer: Tell us what you are sending, the collection address, destination and preferred timing. An item list, approximate weights and dimensions, and details of any access restrictions help us plan your shipment.

items.question: Should I choose air or sea freight?
items.answer: The choice depends on the size of your shipment, your timing and the destination. We review suitable options with you and confirm the route as part of your quote.

items.question: How should I prepare my belongings?
items.answer: Prepare an item list and let us know about fragile, unusually sized or special-care items before packing. We provide packing guidance for the agreed shipment and explain what information is needed before collection.

items.question: Can my belongings be stored before shipping?
items.answer: Storage support can be discussed when your collection and shipping dates do not align. Availability and arrangements are confirmed as part of your shipment plan.

items.question: Will my belongings be delivered to my home?
items.answer: The final handover depends on the destination and agreed service. Tell us if you need home delivery when requesting a quote so we can confirm availability and any access requirements.

hero.title: Storage that keeps your next step in sight
hero.text: Short- and long-term storage in Berlin for personal belongings and retail goods — with careful coordination from warehouse arrival to collection or onward shipping.

introduction.text: DEExpress provides storage and warehousing for private and retail customers in Berlin. Whether your goods are waiting for a shipping date or need space for longer,
introduction.accent: we connect storage, handling and the next handover with personal service.

capabilities: Short- and long-term storage in Berlin
Connected air, sea and road transport

efficiency.title: Space for your goods. Flexibility for your schedule.
efficiency.text: Collection dates, deliveries and shipping schedules do not always align. We bring storage and onward transport into one plan, with the duration and arrangements shaped around your requirements.

process.title: Storage planning & goods receipt
process.text: Tell us what you need to store, how much space it requires and when it will arrive. We confirm suitable arrangements and coordinate the warehouse handover, with any onward shipping requirements considered from the start.

process.title: Storage & shipment coordination
process.text: Your goods are held in Berlin for the agreed period, whether you need a short stay before departure or longer-term space. When several deliveries need to travel together, we discuss consolidation as part of the onward plan.

process.title: Release & onward transport
process.text: When you are ready, we coordinate release for collection or the next shipment. Air, sea or road transport can be connected to your storage arrangements, with the route and handover agreed before your goods leave.

work.title: We handle the work that matters the most

items.title: Space & schedule planning
items.text: Storage requirements reviewed around your goods, expected duration and arrival date, with availability confirmed before the handover.

items.title: Receipt & storage coordination
items.text: Incoming deliveries and warehouse arrangements brought together so your goods enter storage with a clear plan for what follows.

items.title: Shipment consolidation
items.text: Support for bringing goods together before onward transport, with the timing and handling requirements agreed for your shipment.

items.title: Release & onward shipping
items.text: Collection or freight handovers coordinated around the confirmed schedule, connecting your stored goods to their next destination.

items.question: Where is the storage service based?
items.answer: Our storage and warehousing service is based in Berlin. Contact us with your requirements so we can confirm availability and the arrangements for bringing your goods into storage.

items.question: Can both individuals and businesses use the service?
items.answer: Yes. We provide storage for private and retail customers. Share what you need to store, including the item types, quantities and any special handling requirements, so we can confirm suitability.

items.question: Do you offer short- and long-term storage?
items.answer: Yes. Both can be discussed depending on your goods and the space available. Tell us your expected start date and duration, even if the onward shipping date is not yet confirmed.

items.question: What information do you need for a quote?
items.answer: Send a description of the goods, the number of items, boxes or pallets, approximate dimensions and weights, and your expected storage dates. Let us know whether you also need collection, consolidation or onward shipping.

items.question: Can stored goods be shipped internationally afterwards?
items.answer: Yes. Storage can connect to our freight services when your goods are ready to leave. We review the destination, shipment details and timing before confirming the onward route.

items.question: Can several deliveries be stored for one shipment?
items.answer: We can discuss consolidation support where goods need to travel together. Share the expected deliveries and destination so we can review storage, handling and departure arrangements.

hero.title: Vehicle sourcing and shipping, delivered with confidence
hero.text: From finding your vehicle in Europe to shipping it to Africa and the Middle East — we bring purchase support, careful handling and international transport together.

introduction.text: DEExpress provides tailored vehicle sourcing and shipping services for cars, trucks, buses and special equipment. Whether you are buying in Europe or shipping a vehicle you already own,
introduction.accent: we connect every stage with personal service and careful coordination.

capabilities: European vehicle sourcing and purchase support

efficiency.title: One vehicle or a fleet. One connected service.
efficiency.text: From a private purchase to commercial vehicle requirements, we bring sourcing, collection and shipping into one plan — balancing the route, timing and handling needs of your vehicle.

process.title: Vehicle sourcing & purchase support
process.text: Looking for a vehicle in Europe? We support the search, liaise with sellers and assist with purchase negotiations. Inspection and document checks are arranged where available, with shipping requirements considered from the start.

process.title: Collection & export preparation
process.text: Once your vehicle is ready, we coordinate collection, export documents and the port handover. Already own the vehicle? Your journey can begin here, with storage available when collection and departure dates do not align.

process.title: Vehicle loading & sea transport
process.text: From a single car to commercial vehicles, we plan container or roll-on/roll-off transport around the vehicle and destination. Booking, handling and loading arrangements are connected for a carefully managed departure.

process.title: Arrival & onward delivery
process.text: At destination, we coordinate the arrival handover and support the customs-document process. Where available, onward transport connects the port to your final delivery point, with clear communication throughout.

work.title: We handle the work that matters the most

items.title: Sourcing & seller coordination
items.text: Vehicle search, seller liaison and purchase support brought together around your requirements, budget and shipping destination.

items.title: Documents & export preparation
items.text: Coordination of purchase records, export documents and customs paperwork to prepare your vehicle for its international journey.

items.title: Collection & port handling
items.text: Collection, storage and loading arrangements connected to the sailing schedule, with careful handling at every stage.

items.title: Destination delivery
items.text: Arrival and onward transport coordinated around the agreed route, keeping the journey connected beyond the port.

items.question: Can you ship a vehicle I already own?
items.answer: Yes. You can use our shipping service without sourcing or purchase assistance. Share the vehicle details, collection point and destination so we can plan the route.

items.question: Can you help me find and buy a vehicle in Europe?
items.answer: We support vehicle search, seller coordination and purchase negotiations. Tell us the type of vehicle, budget and destination. Inspection and document support are discussed before purchase and arranged where available.

items.question: Should I choose container or RoRo shipping?
items.answer: The choice depends on the vehicle, destination and available sailings. RoRo means roll-on/roll-off transport for suitable vehicles. We review the options with you before confirming the shipment.

items.question: What do you need to prepare a quote?
items.answer: Share the vehicle type, make and model, collection location, destination and preferred timing. Let us know whether you need sourcing, storage or onward delivery as well.

items.question: Can you store the vehicle before departure?
items.answer: Storage can be coordinated when purchase, collection and departure dates do not align. We confirm availability and arrangements as part of the shipment plan.

hero.title: Source the vehicle. Coordinate the journey.
hero.text: Practical support from vehicle search and purchase through international shipping.

introduction.text: We connect sourcing, purchase and onward movement around the vehicle you need,
introduction.accent: so the process stays clear from first search to final handover.
